Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor

Class CompressorShaft.SolveResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.CompressorShaft.SolveResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Enclosing class:
CompressorShaft
public static class CompressorShaft.SolveResult extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable outcome of a CompressorShaft.solveSpeed(neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.Compressor, double, java.lang.String, java.lang.Runnable) call: whether the duty is feasible, why, the target / achieved / min- / max-achievable discharge pressures, and the solved common speed. Never thrown — an infeasible duty is reported here so a caller can gate on it instead of silently proceeding on a saturated speed.
